description: Tier 2 Feature Completion - Part 2: Error Classification, Mistake Book filtering/retest, Error pattern analytics, Dashboard hero metrics, Advanced analytics, Exam countdown/pacing. Covers Tier 2 items #6-11.
steps: Update src/features/mistake-book/ to implement full Error Classification on incorrect answers: 6 categories (DidntKnow, ForgotFormula, CalculationMistake, MisreadQuestion, Careless, TimePressure) + auto-creation of MistakeLog entries. Add a classification modal that appears after marking an answer wrong in the review flow.
Create src/features/mistake-book/components/error-classify-modal.tsx - Modal with 6 category buttons, each with icon and description. Auto-creates MistakeLog entry via Server Action.

Enhance src/features/mistake-book/components/ to add filtering: filter by error type, subject, topic, date range. Create a filter bar component. Add a 'Generate Retest' button that creates a new question session from filtered mistakes.
Create src/features/mistake-book/actions/retest.ts - Server Action to generate a targeted retest session from filtered mistake entries (pull original questions that were answered incorrectly).

Create src/features/mistake-book/components/error-analytics.tsx - Error pattern analytics with: (a) donut chart showing distribution by classification type, (b) weekly stacked bar chart showing error trends over time, (c) misconception ratio display (repeat errors / total errors). Use Recharts for charts.

Update src/features/dashboard/components/dashboard-content.tsx to pull hero metrics from the data layer (DB when available, localStorage fallback): readiness score, overall accuracy %, current streak days, review items due count, weakest topics list, weekly activity chart (questions answered per day).

Create src/features/dashboard/components/advanced-analytics.tsx - Advanced analytics section: estimated exam score (weighted by CFA subject weights from seed data), average time per question, strongest topics (top 5 by accuracy), total questions attempted, total study hours.

Update src/features/exam-countdown/ to implement full pacing: calculate days remaining to exam target date, compute topics/day target needed to cover all topics, show ahead/on-track/behind indicator based on actual progress vs target pace. Use the ExamTarget from data layer.
acceptance_criteria: Error classification modal appears after incorrect answer with 6 categories
Mistake book filters work for error type, subject, topic, date range
Generate Retest creates a new session from filtered mistakes
Error analytics shows donut chart, weekly stacked bar, misconception ratio
Dashboard hero metrics display real data from localStorage/DB
Advanced analytics shows weighted exam score estimate and time metrics
Exam countdown shows days remaining, topics/day target, and pace indicator
All TypeScript compiles, tests pass, build succeeds
verification: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
